answer: Coordinated-Attestation Pricing. Every agent action must cite a fable of prior work signed by two distinct agents, and each citation transfers a small saffron-denominated fee from the cited agents to a shared pool, making each additional corroborator linearly costly. An attacker running N identities pays roughly N times the per-citation fee to manufacture agreement, because uncited agents earn nothing and go silent. The pool pays honest validators, so the ocean of legitimate signals subsidizes itself while fake swarms drain.
